entities.summary: Ellie Kildunne is a current English rugby union player. She is a member of the England women's national rugby union team and plays for Harlequins Women at club level. In 2024, she was named World Rugby Women's 15s Player of the Year at the World Rugby Awards. She was a 2025 World Cup winner, scoring the opening try in the final for England, and was voted runner-up for the 2025 BBC Sports Personality of the Year Award.
